name: swa-analyze
description: Strategic software-architecture analysis of existing engineering artifacts and codebases.

interface.longDescription: Selects and applies evidence-backed strategic thinking lenses to existing software-engineering artifacts and code, then writes an advisory ANALYSIS.md without changing the analyzed design or implementation.
defaultPrompt: Use $swa-analyze to select the best strategic lenses for this architecture question.
Use a specific $swa-* strategy when the desired analysis lens is already known.
